objective: Phase C2 Graph Analytics & Biological Sanity Validation

findings.description: Reproducibility claims fail to state PARTIALLY VERIFIED. Since a fresh independent env wasn't used, this exact classification must be present.

The metric registry still uses the terms 'weighted_in_degree' and 'weighted_out_degree'. Even with caveats explaining they are synapse tallies, the term 'weighted' violates the strict NO weights rule.
Self-edge anomaly of 56,231 successfully identified as a transcription error and verified as 0 in real data tests.
Cell-type terminology correctly isolates any_taxonomic, super_class, and cell_type.
